rich_narrative.summary: The Institute for Understanding Anti-Palestinian Racism focuses on research and education regarding discrimination against Palestinians and their allies. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="1">Total Revenue of $84,465</cite>. Its work includes conducting surveys to document how discrimination affects the mental and physical health of respondents <cite id="2"></cite>. However, significant financial efficiency concerns exist: in FY2024, the charity directed a low program expense ratio of 34.9% toward its core programs, which falls well below the 75% industry standard. Its operations encompass empirical research, education, and advocacy <cite id="4"></cite>. Donors can support its work through general sadaqah contributions <cite id="3"></cite>.
